scope: ATLP / AD Ports channel for MOHRE establishment-card cancellation; not a universal Ministry channel; Taqyeem programme guidance route review

records.finding: The previous Ministry article describes obtaining a cancellation statement, not filing card cancellation. ATLP publishes the matching request via AD Ports, with five channel-specific documents and a displayed 20-minute channel duration. Government/provider charge components and complete eligibility remain unverified; no nationwide fee or timing promise is made.
Both language sources are Taqyeem programme guides with Tasheel-to-provider referral; neither is a direct application card or publishes complete transaction documents, fees, timing or eligibility.
